Interactive Single-Cell Simulation Benchmarking with scSimEvalStudio

Source: vignettes/scSimEvalStudio-workflow.Rmd
scSimEvalStudio-workflow.Rmd

Introduction

scSimEvalStudio provides the interactive Shiny graphical studio companion for scSimEval. While scSimEval focuses cleanly on Bioconductor programmatic evaluation across SingleCellExperiment objects and reproducibility pipelines, scSimEvalStudio exposes point-and-click dataset uploads, real-time evaluation progress logs, pre-saved .rds exploration, interactive zoomable plots, and Excel/figure exports.

Installation

Install the package from Bioconductor with:

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("BiocManager")
}
BiocManager::install("scSimEvalStudio")

Launching the Shiny Studio

After installing both scSimEval and scSimEvalStudio, launch the interactive studio from R:

library(scSimEvalStudio)
launch_scSimEval_app()

By default, launch_scSimEval_app() configures shiny.maxRequestSize to 10 GiB (10 * 1024^3) so large multiomics .rds archives can be loaded locally.

Verifying Application Initialization

In automated or non-interactive environments, you can confirm that the bundled Shiny application initializes cleanly and inspects the bundled demonstration benchmark dataset:

library(scSimEvalStudio)

app_dir <- system.file("shiny", "scSimEvalApp", package = "scSimEvalStudio")
dir.exists(app_dir)
#> [1] TRUE

app <- shiny::shinyAppDir(app_dir)
#> Loading required package: shiny
#> 
#> Attaching package: 'bslib'
#> The following object is masked from 'package:utils':
#> 
#>     page
#> 
#> Attaching package: 'DT'
#> The following objects are masked from 'package:shiny':
#> 
#>     dataTableOutput, renderDataTable
class(app)
#> [1] "shiny.appobj"

demo_file <- file.path(app_dir, "data", "demo_benchmark_data.rds")
demo_obj <- readRDS(demo_file)
names(demo_obj)
#> [1] "benchmark_df"            "benchmark_summary_table"
#> [3] "dataset_summary_df"      "methods"
head(demo_obj$benchmark_summary_table[, c("Method", "Category", "Metric", "Score")], 6)
#>                  Method                      Category         Metric     Score
#> scMultiSim.1 scMultiSim (I) Distributional Properties    Wasserstein 0.7190470
#> scMultiSim.2 scMultiSim (I) Distributional Properties             KS 0.5516079
#> scMultiSim.3 scMultiSim (I) Distributional Properties            MAD 0.0000000
#> scMultiSim.4 scMultiSim (I) Distributional Properties  Bhattacharyya 0.5304023
#> scMultiSim.5 scMultiSim (I) Distributional Properties Runs_Statistic 0.7451238
#> scMultiSim.6 scMultiSim (I) Distributional Properties    NN_Mismatch 0.6441069

Bioconductor Ecosystem Integration

scSimEvalStudio accepts SingleCellExperiment objects (including multi-modal SingleCellExperiment objects with altExp assays and colData annotations cell_type and batch) evaluated directly by scSimEval::evaluate_simulation_accuracy() and scSimEval::evaluate_multiomics_accuracy().
